title: Measles Returned With 2,289 US Cases
hook: Eliminated nationally, measles returned with 2,289 cases.
closing: Vaccination gaps can bring a supposedly defeated disease back into classrooms.
question: Did you think measles was gone?

segments.say: US measles cases reached 2,289, reversing the expectation that national elimination meant the disease was gone.
Unvaccinated people made up 93% of cases, tying the comeback to gaps in protection.
The Texas outbreak reached 702 cases, showing how one vulnerable pocket can drive national spread.
